description: Read a local Git repository and write a portable .gitferry bundle of commits, staged/unstaged changes, and untracked files. only=repo instead captures tracked files as a snapshot. Review untracked files for secrets before sharing. No network transfer is performed.

base.description: Ref/sha the bundle applies onto (default: merge-base with the upstream tracking branch)

cwd.description: Absolute path to the git repository (or any directory inside it)

includeWorktree.description: Include staged AND unstaged changes; master switch over includeStaged/includeUnstaged (default true)

only.description: Select all, uncommitted, staged, unstaged, committed, or repo (tracked-file snapshot). Default all. Include flags can further narrow the selection; repo is exclusive.

output.description: Output bundle path; defaults to <repo>-<branch>-<sha>.gitferry in cwd

portable.description: Write a plain ZIP for git + unzip targets instead of the smaller Brotli-wrapped format (default false)

name: pack_changes
title: Pack local Git changes
